item.title: Citrus 1.2
item.description: • A More ring on the wheel for less common formats, and right-click settings for one conversion. New: camera RAW, Photoshop, JPEG XL, DSD, MIDI, LaTeX, Typst and Jupyter notebooks in; ICNS, ICO, traced SVG, Apple Lossless, audiobooks and cover-art videos out. 24-bit sound stays 24-bit, and misnamed files are read as what they really are.
